第一次去东湾，容易把湖边、校园、山景和海边全塞进一天。更舒服的做法是只选一个起点: On a first East Bay outing, it's tempting to fit the lake, campus, hills, and waterfront into one day. A more comfortable plan is one small area with a clear starting point and an easy way to turn back. These two options combine walking and BART, with meals and seated breaks included. They are alternatives, not two halves you need to finish back to back.
出门前，先选今天想要的节奏: Before heading out, choose your pace for the day
想看水面、聊天、少研究建筑，选 Oakland；想逛校园边缘与街区，选 Berk: Choose Oakland for water views, conversation, and less focus on architecture; choose Berkeley for campus edges and neighborhood streets. Allow about half a day for either, with walking time adjusted to your group's stamina. Neither route assumes spending at a business or entering a museum. If rain arrives or energy drops, shorten the walk and return to the station.
路线 A：Lake Merritt 南岸短程往返: Route A: A short out-and-back along Lake Merritt's south shore
起点和终点都是 Lake Merritt BART 站。出站后沿 Oak Str: Start and end at Lake Merritt BART station. Walk north on Oak Street toward 12th Street, following crosswalks and waterfront signs to the south-shore path. Sit by the lake first, then walk along the south shore toward the channel bridge on Lake Merritt Boulevard. Rest near the bridge, turn back, and retrace your route to the station. Take your time at intersections and follow open routes around barriers.
BART 官方步行介绍确认车站距湖边不远，但完整环湖约五公里；“到湖边看看”和“: BART's official walking guide confirms the station is close to the lake, but the full loop is about five kilometers. A quick waterfront visit and a complete circuit are different outings. Choosing a turnaround point is better for a first visit than feeling obliged to finish a loop on a map. To visit the gardens on the north side, check Oakland's Lakeside Park page for location and facilities, and allow extra walking time.
路线 B：Downtown Berkeley 与校园西侧: Route B: Downtown Berkeley and the west side of campus
起点为 Downtown Berkeley BART 站，走向 Center S: Start at Downtown Berkeley BART station, head toward Center Street and Shattuck Avenue, then walk east on Center Street to the campus edge at Oxford Street—the direction given on UC Berkeley's official visitor page. Once on campus, use the official map to find West Crescent, then stroll southeast toward Sather Gate. Stick to outdoor paths; academic buildings are not attractions you can enter freely.
从 Sather Gate 往南经过 Sproul Plaza 到 Bancro: From Sather Gate, head south through Sproul Plaza to Bancroft Way. Follow Bancroft west to Shattuck, then north to Downtown Berkeley station to complete a small loop. Parts of campus are sloped; check street names and turns against the official map and signs. If anyone gets tired, return from the west side of campus along Center Street instead. The outing is just as worthwhile.
开放安排决定加项，不反过来赶路: Let opening hours shape optional stops, not a rushed itinerary
散步能经过的地方，不代表其中每一处花园、展馆或楼宇都开放。Oakland 市的公: Being able to walk past a place doesn't mean every garden, gallery, or building there is open. Oakland's parks page lists multiple facilities; check the individual facility before entering. For a Berkeley tour or tower visit, check Visitor Services. Don't make an unconfirmed indoor visit a must-do just because you're nearby.
把集合与返程写得具体一点: Be specific about meeting up and getting home
出发前在 BART 官网查当天路线、运营调整和返程方向，需要电梯时额外查设备状态: Before leaving, check BART's official site for that day's route, service changes, and return direction. If you need an elevator, check its status too.
约定具体车站和集合出口，写清迟到怎样联系，避免只发“湖边见”或“校园见”。: Agree on a specific station and exit, and how to make contact if someone is late. Avoid vague plans like “meet by the lake” or “on campus.”
带水、防风外层和充好电的手机；路线上先标一个可以提前折返的位置。: Bring water, a windproof layer, and a charged phone. Mark a place where you can turn back early.
推婴儿车或行动不便时，事先核对连续的人行路线，不用楼梯或陡坡抄近路。: With a stroller or limited mobility, check for a continuous pedestrian route beforehand. Don't take shortcuts using stairs or steep slopes.
返程前留出找站口与换乘余量；跨城吃饭若要排队，先判断是否会压缩回程。: Allow time to find the station entrance and make transfers on the way back. If a meal in another city involves a line, consider whether it leaves enough time for your return trip.
到了现场，可以用一个简单问题决定要不要加点：走过去以后，还愿意再走回来吗？若答案: Once there, ask one simple question before adding another stop: After walking there, will I still want to walk back? If you're unsure, stay put, drink water, chat, and watch the city for a while. Your first weekend is a chance to learn how you like to explore. You can widen your range next time.

看飞机与历史舰船，再到海岸放松；航母需票且通行有限，海岸是独立转场。: Explore aircraft and a historic carrier, then unwind by the bay; the ship needs a ticket and has limited access, and the shore requires a separate transfer.
